messages:
zoe: Uploaded a fresh draft of the launch post (internal link in drive). Need a quick runway check: 1) 1-line lead, 2) benchmark claim + footnote wording, 3) hero + footer CTAs, 4) demo/webinar routing by region. Can we tidy by EOD? :wave:

matt: On it. Quick Q about the benchmark numbers  are these Dedicated internal runs or public comparisons? we should call out hardware and precision.

zoe: Dedicated internal runs on H100S clusters (mixed precision int8 path). Measurement window: Apr 2-9, 2026. Current claim reads: "up to 3.8x lower token cost vs baseline fp16 serving." Open to safer phrasing.

claire: Legal quick-pass: prefer: "up to 3.8x in internal performance benchmarks (see methodology)". Add hardware, dates, baseline details in the footnote and avoid language implying guarantees or savings. Also change "our tests" -> "internal performance benchmarks".

nina: Growth ops: CTA ideas
- Hero primary: "Schedule an enterprise deep-dive"
- Hero secondary: "See the performance brief"
- Footer: "Request trial access"
Routing plan: webinar sign-ups -> marketing nurture; deep-dive/demo -> SDR by region; trial -> product ops. For EMEA route to EMEA SDR 08:30-18:30 CET; outside that window fallback to NA SDR.

matt: Exec lead suggestion (very short): "Redwood Inference: predictable, production-grade LLM serving." Cleaner and product-focused.

zoe: Love it, swapping that in. Also drafting a demo-slot matrix by ARR tier/region for ops. Pasting CSV for handoff:
```
region,company_arr_tier,engagement,owner,preferred_window
NA,<$5M,Intro live demo,sd-na-01,09:00-11:00 ET
NA,$5M-$50M,Technical walkthrough,sd-na-02,13:00-16:00 ET
NA,>$50M,Architecture deep-dive,sd-na-03,14:00-17:00 ET
EMEA,<$5M,Recorded + scheduler,sd-emea-01,09:00-12:00 CET
EMEA,$5M-$50M,Technical walkthrough,sd-emea-02,13:00-16:00 CET
EMEA,>$50M,Live architecture deep-dive,sd-emea-03,14:00-17:30 CET
APAC,Any,Recorded + local-calendar,sd-apac-01,Weekdays SGT
```

release-bot: NOTE: Embargo in effect UNTIL 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC. Add metadata `embargo: true` to the document and remove public links until release. :lock:

claire: Legal approves the revised footnote text if the methodology doc includes sequence-length distribution, batching details, and baseline config. Also request changing phrasing to "internal performance benchmarks" for consistency.

nina: Ops confirms HubSpot routing and will post the nurture tags + SDR queue IDs in this thread by 15:30 PT. Also proposing CTA A/B: 65% "Schedule an enterprise deep-dive" / 35% "See the performance brief" for hero.

matt: Small copy nit: replace "lower token cost" with "lower per-token cost" in the bench line for clarity. So final suggestion: 'up to 3.8x lower per-token cost in internal performance benchmarks (see methodology).'

zoe: Updated doc: swapped lead to Matt's line, updated benchmark phrasing per Matt and Claire, added methodology link and test metadata, pasted demo CSV above, and set embargo flag. Plan: lock CTAs (A/B split), handoff to design for hero + secondary CTA, ops to wire HubSpot. Final review here by 17:00 UTC and then we schedule publish tasks. :rocket:
